findings.title: Preserve the full-width action description when switching to flexbox
findings.body: Making `.small-action` a flex container turns `.small-action-desc` into an auto-sized flex item with no flex growth. It therefore no longer fills the remaining row width. The existing right-floated action button inside the description is positioned beside the description text rather than at the right edge of the row. Give the description the remaining space (for example, with `flex: 1` and an appropriate minimum width) so action controls retain their previous placement.
